description: A TypeScript dashboard: package manager, component layout, generated API types and a styling migration.

memories.text: Use pnpm, not npm or yarn: the lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml and CI runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile.
The package manager is pnpm; running npm install creates a package-lock.json that conflicts with pnpm-lock.yaml and fails CI.
Add dependencies with pnpm add (never npm install) so pnpm-lock.yaml stays the only lockfile.
Components live in src/components/<Name>/ with a colocated <Name>.test.tsx; tests run with vitest via pnpm test.
Styling uses styled-components; put a component's styles in a styles.ts file next to it.
Styling uses CSS modules (<Name>.module.css next to the component); styled-components was removed in March.
API types are generated from openapi.yaml by pnpm gen:api into src/api/types.ts; never edit that file by hand.
The storybook build on 2026-07-30 failed because the runner's disk was full.
Opened the dashboard at http://localhost:5173 after the change and the settings page rendered correctly.
While debugging the chart I added console.log calls to Chart.tsx; remove them before merging.
